summary: Frontend-only test of the restyled Kiosk section and new PriceAdvisor on /?landing=1 at 1440, 1024, 768 and 390 widths. Kiosk: cream bg rgb(251,248,245), eyebrow 'KIOSK PWA', heading 'Selfservice in / vier tikken.', subtitle, HTML tablet with amounts and numpad, and 4 white step cards (01-04, label, desc, images load). The tablet is centered with no horizontal overflow at 1440 (616px wide, scale 1.1), 1024, 768 and 390 (350px, inside 20-370). Nav secnav-kiosk works: h2 at 318px, header bottom at 77px. PriceAdvisor: default 25 shows Starter 3.000; 1/100 -> Starter; 101/500 -> Professional 5.000; 501/600/2500 -> Enterprise 'Op maat'; 0 and empty -> 1. Plus/minus and slider work. Lifetime is never advised. The CTA opens RegisterModal with the badge 'U KOOS: PROFESSIONAL' or 'U KOOS: STARTER', and the Enterprise CTA opens enterprise-modal. All were closed without submitting. Rest of the landing is fine: sections home/features/kiosk/pricing/faq/download, footer, 4 plan cards, no broken images. The only console error is the expected 401 from /api/auth/me for anonymous visitors. One UX bug: the number input is clamped on every change, so you cannot clear it and type a new number.

ui_bugs.issue: onChange clamps empty/NaN to 1 right away, so the user cannot clear the field. Select all + Backspace + typing '150' gives '1150', which advises Enterprise instead of Professional. Fix: keep a raw string state (allow ''), and clamp only on blur or when computing the plan (treat '' as 1).

issues: The tablet is scaled to about 0.625, so its inner text (6.5-9px base) is about 4-6px and unreadable. It is decorative, but consider a slightly larger base font or a taller layout on mobile.
Enterprise is called 'Op maat' in the advisor but 'Custom' on the plan card. Use the same word.
Feature card titles (e.g. 'Huurdersbeheer', 'Boekhouding') overlap the chevron icon at 1024 width. Seen in passing; may already have existed.

action_items: Fix the PriceAdvisor input so users can clear it and type (string state, clamp on blur)
Optional: use 'Op maat' or 'Custom' everywhere for Enterprise
Optional: fix the feature-card title/chevron overlap at 1024px
critical_code_review_comments: KioskPricing.jsx set(): parseInt('') -> NaN -> 1 on every keystroke, which causes the typing bug above.
pickPlan correctly excludes lifetime/enterprise/amount 0 and sorts by amount. It treats max_apartments null/-1 as unlimited, which is fine.
The input clamps to max 2000 silently. That is OK, but 2500 shows as 2000 in the text 'Voor 2.000 appartementen'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kiosk and PriceAdvisor verified on /?landing=1. Register modal close: data-testid register-close, plan badge: chosen-plan-badge. Enterprise modal: enterprise-modal / enterprise-close. The 401 on /api/auth/me is expected for anonymous users.
